name: Exp_XMA_Range_Bands
summary: This EA trades breakouts from the XMA_Range_Bands channel indicator. It opens buy positions when price closes above the upper band and sell positions when price closes below the lower band, with optional permissions for entry and exit. Positions are managed using fixed stop loss and take profit levels with configurable money management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XMA_Range_Bands通道指标进行突破交易。当价格收盘突破上轨时开多仓，跌破下轨时开空仓，支持入场和出场的独立权限控制。持仓使用固定止损止盈和可配置的资金管理方式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于XMA_Range_Bands通道的突破交易。XMA_Range_Bands指标由一条移动平均中轨和上下两条通道带组成，通道宽度由K线振幅的平滑值乘以偏差系数决定。入场条件为：当收盘价从通道内突破上轨时触发买入信号，从通道内跌破下轨时触发卖出信号，且要求前一根K线的收盘价仍在通道内以确保是真正的突破而非已经处于通道外。出场条件依赖固定的止损止盈点数，同时当反向突破信号出现时也会主动平仓（如价格跌破下轨时平多头，突破上轨时平空头）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值为固定手数，正值代表存款比例。策略默认使用H4周期，结合多种平滑算法（SMA、JJMA等），适合捕捉中长期趋势的启动阶段。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a breakout system based on the XMA_Range_Bands channel indicator. The XMA_Range_Bands consists of a moving average center line and upper/lower bands calculated from smoothed candle range multiplied by a deviation factor. Entry conditions trigger a buy signal when the close price breaks above the upper band from inside the channel, and a sell signal when the close price breaks below the lower band from inside the channel. The EA requires the previous bar's close to still be within the band to confirm a genuine breakout rather than an existing outside position. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit in points, while counter-breakout signals also trigger position closure — a break below the lower band closes longs, and a break above the upper band closes shorts. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit. The strategy defaults to the H4 timeframe with configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA, JJMA, etc.), making it suitable for catching the early stages of medium-to-long-term trends.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit fraction or fixed lot; negative value = lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 用于指标计算的价格常量

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用通道突破策略逻辑清晰，入场条件明确，适合趋势行情
支持多种平滑算法选择（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX、T3等），适应性强
买卖入场和出场权限独立控制，灵活性高，可单向交易
突破确认逻辑要求前一根K线仍在通道内，减少了假突破风险
使用IsNewBar检测避免同一根K线内重复开仓
pros_en: Clear channel breakout logic with well-defined entry conditions suitable for trending markets
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, T3, etc.) providing high adaptability
Independent buy/sell entry and exit permission controls offer flexible directional trading
Breakout confirmation requiring the previous bar to still be inside the band reduces false breakout risk
Uses IsNewBar detection to prevent repeated entries within the same bar
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，不根据市场波动性（ATR）动态调整，在不同行情下可能不合适
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
缺乏点差过滤和波动性过滤，在窄幅震荡市中容易频繁假突破导致亏损
MM参数正负值含义不同但缺乏输入验证，容易误设
没有追踪止损或移动止盈机制，趋势行情中可能无法最大化利润
cons_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit in points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment may be unsuitable across varying market conditions
No position check logic exists, potentially leading to duplicate entries in the same direction
Lacks spread filter and volatility filter, prone to frequent false breakout losses in narrow ranging markets
MM parameter has different meaning for positive vs negative values but lacks input validation,easilymisconfiguration
No trailing stop or dynamic take profit mechanism to maximize profits during trending moves
improvements: 增加持仓检查，避免同方向重复开仓，并可限制最大持仓数量
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，适应不同市场波动环境
增加通道宽度过滤或ADX趋势强度过滤，在窄幅震荡时禁止交易
improvements_en: Add position check to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction and allow maximum position count limits
Replace fixed SL/TP with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to varying market volatility
Add channel width filter or ADX trend strength filter to suppress trading during narrow ranging conditions

risk_points: 没有持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定点数止损在极端行情下可能不足，在高波动品种上止损可能过小
突破策略在震荡市中容易产生连续亏损
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries increasing risk exposure
Fixed point stop loss may be insufficient in extreme volatility conditions or too tight for high-volatility instruments
Breakout strategy tends to produce consecutive losses in ranging/choppy markets
